company.shortDescription: VEON (Nasdaq: VEON) is a digital operator that provides converged connectivity and digital services to nearly 160 million customers.
company.description: VEON is a Nasdaq-listed digital operator headquartered in Dubai that provides converged connectivity and digital services to nearly 160 million customers. Operating across six countries that are home to more than 7% of the world’s population, VEON is transforming lives through technology-driven services that empower individuals and drive economic growth. For more information visit: www.veon.com

items.description: VEON completed an infrastructure partnership in Pakistan with Engro Corporation, transferring tower assets via Deodar into Engro Connect at an enterprise value of USD 562.7 million. Jazz will lease this infrastructure under a long-term agreement, supporting its digital services transition.

sources.title: Jazz Grows Revenue, But Cracks Show in Profit Margins & Cost Pressures

items.description: VEON and Engro Corporation have secured all regulatory approvals and are advancing to close a strategic infrastructure partnership in Pakistan. The agreement involves pooling and managing telecommunications infrastructure assets, with VEON's assets under Deodar (Private) Limited vesting into Engro Connect, a subsidiary of Engro Corp. Engro will pay Jazz approximately USD 188 million and guarantee repayment of Deodar’s intercompany debt of USD 375 million. The partnership aims to enhance infrastructure efficiency and support Pakistan's digital transformation.

sources.title: VEON and Engro Corporation Advance to Closing Pioneering Infrastructure Partnership in Pakistan Following Regulatory Approvals

items.description: VEON and Airspan have signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) to collaborate on air-to-land network solutions aimed at supporting Ukraine's resilience. This partnership involves VEON Ltd and Airspan Networks working together to enhance digital infrastructure in Ukraine.

sources.title: VEON And Airspan Sign MoU To Collaborate On Air-To-Land Network Solutions Supporting Ukraine's Resilience
